notes:
- Company snapshot: mid-market conversational SaaS aimed at help desks and chat support. Heavy EU customer base ~35%.
- Started with Hosted API to validate model quality; now moving to Dedicated for predictable economics and residency.
- Key technical requirements: model version pinning, KV/prefix caching across sessions, support for mixed-precision or 8-bit quantization to cut costs.
- SLA ask: 95th percentile latency under 110ms (NA/EU), monthly availability 99.95%. Wants credits or service fee reduction on sustained breaches.
- Legal asks: carve-out for EU customer data, strict deletion windows after retention period, subprocessors finalized before go-live. DPA must include standard SCCs or equivalent.
- Procurement: vendor onboarding has 60 questions; security has approved ~80% but needs SOC2 report and list of third-party subprocessors.
- Pricing: wants two-tier reserved capacity model (base commit + predictable burst) and transparent per-suggestion token accounting (suggestion + rerank counted separately).
- Integration: require SSO + SCIM, BYOK/KMS for encryption keys, option for VPC peering or private link.
- Quote from VP Ops: "We can tolerate minor latency but can't have unpredictable cost spikes during ticket storms."
- Operational plan: run staging Dedicated for 2 weeks to validate SLA and throughput, then ramp to prod over 4 weeks.
- Stakeholders: VP Product (Carla Mendes), Head of Security (Noah Wright), Procurement (Ellen Park).
